prs.appendixTitle: Campaign creative export — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 8) (derived)

status.note: campaign creative export — part 2, the producer (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.1, C8.5, C8.6 item 7; no registry change, no migration): `@extas/creative-studio`'s `export.ts` gains `produceCreativeExport`, called on a `DRAFT` or previously-`FAILED` export (`WRONG_STATE` on any other status, including a second attempt on an already-`READY` one — `assembleReel`/`retryVideoJob`'s own "never throws on a stale selection, just lands the terminal failure status, retry freely" shape). It never trusts the request-time check: it re-reads the selection's first approved (non-archived) `ProductMedia` asset fresh, at production time. Found, it fills one output per chosen platform size, every one that same real asset's own file — the honest preview PR 439/482/485/486/487 already set, never a real crop, overlay or ad-account send (no crop engine in the stack yet) — and the row moves to `READY`. Not found (the selection's approved media moved since the request), the row moves to `FAILED` instead of throwing, with no attempt cap, so producing again once new media is approved just re-runs the same check. Marketing › Studio › Export: a `DRAFT` or `FAILED` row now shows "Produce this export" (`{action: 'produce', exportId}`, `marketing.studio.write`); a `READY` row shows a plain note that this is a preview, not a real sized ad file; `FAILED` keeps its "Produce this export" retry button and a `DRAFT` row keeps its cancel button alongside it. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/marketing/studio-export.md` updated for the produce step. 6 new `.db.test.ts` cases (real PostgreSQL, run against a live `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` this session, 25/25 in the file, 83/83 in the package): produces READY with the right outputAssetIds from the first media by sort order; lands FAILED, never throws, when the media is archived before production; a FAILED export can be retried once media exists again, no cap; refuses a second produce on an already-READY export; refuses producing a CANCELLED export; refuses an unknown export id.

status.note: To ship screen (CN-048; one new setting `fulfilment.toShip` with two switches, both off; no migration, no new permission): the To ship tab (`/admin/orders/packing`) gets the three chips Confirmed (no courier booked yet), Booked (courier booked, sticker not printed) and Packed (sticker printed, ready for the rider) with their counts (`shipChips`, read only, the same filters as the steps) and a Print log link. Switch 1, "A second print needs the owner's PIN": a reprint asks for the reason and then the owner's books PIN (PIN_REQUIRED, WRONG_PIN, PIN_NOT_SET or PIN_LOCKED change nothing and count nothing; the PIN is never stored, the print job only records that it was checked and the Recent prints line says "PIN checked"). Switch 2, "A printed sticker means packed": printing a confirmed or picking order's sticker marks it Packed through the order service (no piece scan; an order that cannot be packed stays as it is). Select all, the filters, one-click booking with a courier chosen per press, the summary line and Print all already existed (PR 182, 410, 411). status.note: With courier: live status, stuck alert, backup courier (CN-048; one new setting `fulfilment.courierWatch`: stuck alert off, 48 hours, no backup courier; no migration, no new permission): the With courier tab (`/admin/orders/packing/handover`) gets, above the rider's handover cards, the Day-end check (orders packed today against the ones entered at a courier, with the numbers of the missing ones) and "With the courier now" — each parcel a courier holds with its last reported status, when it last moved and what it is to collect, a status filter, a History drawer with the whole tracking history (every courier event, the failed delivery tries counted, the rider's note when the courier sends one), a "Cancelled but still booked" mark on a parcel whose order is cancelled, and a "Stuck" mark when the owner's alert is on and a parcel has not moved for the hours set. "Move to the backup courier" (the owner's PIN, `delivery.book`) closes the parcels the first courier has not picked up as re-booked and books the same orders again with the backup courier; a parcel already picked up is left. New `withCourier`, `parcelHistory` and `moveToBackup` in `@extas/shipping`, db tests on PostgreSQL. Honest scope: nothing is cancelled at a courier from here (a person cancels there and says how); the stuck alert is a mark on the page and a count, with no Telegram or Home alert yet; no auto refresh.
